content.short: Xangle is a Web3 data research platform trusted by financial and tech giants.
content.description: Xangle is a Web3 data research platform that serves as a gateway to Web3 adoption in South Korea. It delivers comprehensive intelligence solutions built on proprietary data analytics, with a strong emphasis on fundamental on-chain data to illuminate project ecosystems and the broader sector. In South Korea, more than 4,000 institutions in finance and gaming rely on reports drawn from Xangle’s on-chain analytics to understand how individual projects fit within the overall market and industry trends.
content.meta: Xangle is a Web3 data research platform focused on on-chain data and institutional insights. Discover Xangle and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
